free_tier.stated: Starter: 2 GB serverless storage, 5 indexes, 1 project, 1 GB egress per month, us-east-1 only

per_object_cap.stated: 2 GB of index storage per organization; 100 namespaces per index

retention.stated: free indexes are kept indefinitely; Pinecone removed the inactivity auto-archive policy, so no deletion clock applies to Starter.
retention.notes: null is indefinite: the inactivity policy was removed, so no inactivity or expiry deletion applies to Starter.

egress.terms: 1 GB per month on Starter. Builder is 10 GB; Standard includes 100 GB then USD 0.10/GB

interface_detail: a REST API for data and control planes; Python, Node and Java SDKs; the pinecone CLI
tooling: the Pinecone SDKs and CLI; no Postgres extension path
chaining: a free vector index that mostly matters for a workload too large for pgvector on a free Postgres, because pgvector is already available on both Neon and Supabase at no extra cost

limits.value: 2 GB of storage per organization, not per index
1 GB egress per month on Starter
5 indexes, 1 project per organization, us-east-1 only, and 100 namespaces per index
no connection limit is published for Starter; recorded as a gap
exceeding Starter limits after downgrading may block new requests until usage is within limits

identity_cost.detail: email signup; no card on Starter

reliability_note: no suspension, throttle or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read
confidence_note: the pricing comparison table was read on 2026-10-22. The 1 GB monthly egress is on it. The project and index counts are on the pricing page too; they are recorded against it rather than against the object-limits page, which does not state them.

evidence.proved: Starter: storage up to 2 GB, egress up to 1 GB/month, indexes up to 5, namespaces per index 100; Builder USD 25 with 10 GB storage and 10 GB egress; Standard unlimited at USD 0.33/GB-month
new users keep their free indexes indefinitely and there is no auto-archiving of inactive indexes
evidence.quote: Over the coming weeks, we will be opening up instant sign ups for all users, and allowing new users to keep their free indexes indefinitely. No more waitlist, no more auto-archiving of inactive indexes.

evidence.proved: Pinecone removed the inactivity policy, so no inactivity day count applies
evidence.quote: Update: Pinecone has since removed the free plan waitlist and the inactivity policy.

evidence.proved: exceeding Starter limits blocks new requests until usage is within limits
evidence.quote: If you exceed Starter limits after downgrading, new requests may be blocked until usage is within limits.

evidence.proved: deletion is tied to account deactivation for non-payment, not to inactivity
evidence.quote: If your account is deactivated for continued non-payment, account data is retained for 30 days before permanent deletion.

notes: 2 GB is an organization-level cap and one project is the whole allowance, so there is no way to shard around it. 1 GB a month of egress is 33 MB a day, which a retrieval workload serving embeddings exceeds before the 2 GB of storage matters.
